stories.title: Al jaren voortvluchtige Oussama B., die hielp bij voorbereiden moord advocaat Derk Wiersum, opgepakt in Parijs

en.title: Long-fugitive Oussama B., who helped prepare murder of lawyer Derk Wiersum, arrested in Paris
en.summary: A man wanted for years in connection with preparing the murder of Dutch lawyer Derk Wiersum has been arrested in Paris. He allegedly helped coordinate surveillance of the lawyer's home and office, and arranged vehicles for the shooters.

stories.title: AZ start Europa League-seizoen met nederlaag bij Sunderland en uitblinker Roefs

en.title: AZ starts Europa League season with defeat at Sunderland and standout Roefs
en.summary: AZ Alkmaar began their Europa League campaign with a 1-0 loss to Sunderland. Goalkeeper Robin Roefs made several important saves in an otherwise unsuccessful performance.

stories.title: Fed verhoogt Amerikaanse rente voor het eerst in drie jaar, tegen de wil van Trump in

en.title: Fed raises US interest rate for first time in three years, against Trump's wishes
en.summary: The US Federal Reserve has increased interest rates for the first time in three years, a decision contrary to the preferences expressed by Trump.

stories.title: Man zwaargewond na val van 12 meter tijdens aanval van Aziatische hoornaars

en.title: Man severely injured after 12-meter fall during attack by Asian hornets
en.summary: A man in Vught sustained serious injuries when he jumped approximately 12 meters from a elevated work platform to escape an attack by Asian hornets while trimming a tree.

stories.title: Fed verhoogt voor het eerst in drie jaar de rente en negeert wens Trump

en.title: Fed raises interest rates for first time in three years, defying Trump's wishes
en.summary: The U.S. Federal Reserve increased its benchmark interest rate to 3.75-4 percent, marking the first rate hike in over three years. The decision contradicts President Trump's preference for rate cuts under new Fed chair Kevin Warsh.

stories.title: Na 15 jaar wisselt Sints mijter van drager: Stefan de Walle stopt als goedheiligman

en.title: After 15 years, Saint changes hands: Stefan de Walle steps down as goodheiligman
en.summary: Stefan de Walle is ending his 15-year tenure as the person portraying Saint Nicholas in what appears to be a Dutch cultural tradition.

stories.title: Amerikaanse bank verhoogt rente tegen wens Trump in voor het eerst in drie jaar

en.title: American bank raises interest rates against Trump's wishes for the first time in three years
en.summary: Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh increased the interest rate to 3.75-4 percent on Wednesday, acting contrary to President Trump's preferences in what represents the first rate hike under his leadership.

stories.title: Opnieuw probleem met brug: Rijkswaterstaat sluit A15 richting Maasvlakte deels om scheurtjes Suurhoffbrug

en.title: Bridge problem again: Rijkswaterstaat partially closes A15 toward Maasvlakte due to cracks in Suurhoff Bridge
en.summary: The A15 highway is partially closed due to cracks discovered in the Suurhoff Bridge, affecting approximately 15,500 daily truck crossings and disrupting operations for numerous businesses in the Rotterdam port area.

stories.title: Voortvluchtige Oussama B. gepakt in Parijs, hielp bij voorbereiden moord Derk Wiersum

en.title: Fugitive Oussama B. arrested in Paris, helped prepare murder of Derk Wiersum
en.summary: Oussama B., wanted in connection with preparations for the murder of lawyer Derk Wiersum, has been arrested in Paris. He was sentenced to over eleven years in prison on appeal in September.

stories.title: Oussama B. na jaren opgepakt voor voorbereiding moord Wiersum

en.title: Oussama B. arrested after years for preparation of Wiersum murder
en.summary: Oussama B. was arrested Wednesday in Paris after years on the run. He received an over eleven-year prison sentence on appeal for his involvement in the murder of lawyer Derk Wiersum.

stories.title: Suurhoffbrug richting Maasvlakte deels gesloten vanwege scheuren in de constructie

en.title: Suurhoffbrug towards Maasvlakte partially closed due to cracks in the structure
en.summary: The western Suurhoffbrug on the A15 has been partially closed after inspections found cracks in one of the bridge's main beams. Two lanes toward Maasvlakte are closed and traffic is being diverted onto the emergency lane.

stories.title: Scheuren in brug richting Maasvlakte, verkeer op A15 moet via vluchtstrook

en.title: Cracks found in bridge toward Maasvlakte, A15 traffic diverted to emergency lane
en.summary: Cracks were discovered Wednesday in the main beam of the western Suurhoffbrug bridge leading to Maasvlakte. Both lanes have been closed for safety, with traffic redirected to the emergency lane.
